summary: Key competitors: Elevance Health (ELV), CVS Health/Aetna (CVS), Humana (HUM), Cigna (CI), Centene (CNC), Molina Healthcare (MOH). All major insurers (UNH, ELV, CI, HUM) beat Q1 2026 estimates, with some raising 2026 outlooks. Sector-wide challenge: elevated medical costs and Medicare Advantage profitability pressure. Humana pivoting fully to senior care. CVS most similar vertically integrated model. UNH projects $450-455B revenue for 2026, maintaining market leadership.
